title: Copilot Studio: interactive MCP apps render inside agent conversations
summary: Hold: the data-policy automation column supplies Get-DlpPolicy, which only reads policies and cannot apply the connector block shown alongside it. The roadmap facts and the documented MCP app capabilities are supported; the data-policy navigation also needs its omitted wizard headings restored.

claims.fix: Use the full path: Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > New Policy > Next > Add an environment > Available > environment > Add to policy > Next > Assign connectors > connector > three dots (⋮) > Block. Apply this to controls[3].ui.path and the rendered table.

claims.claim: Get-DlpPolicy is the automation counterpart of the connector-blocking control.
claims.quote: Retrieves a list of DLP policy objects.
claims.fix: Replace controls[3].api.call and the rendered call with Add-ConnectorsToPolicy -PolicyName <policy-guid> -Classification Blocked -Connectors <connector-objects>. Use https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoft.powerapps.administration.powershell/add-connectorstopolicy?view=pa-ps-latest as api.docs and add it to sources. Replace the row's Get-DlpPolicy note and its closing prose with: 'Add-ConnectorsToPolicy moves the specified connectors into the Blocked group. Each connector object must contain id, type, and name.' The reference explicitly accepts Blocked and documents these three required properties.
